description: Status of any transaction on 7 EVM chains: pending / success / reverted, confirmations, block time, from/to, value and the all-in fee (including the OP-stack L1 data fee on Base and Optimism). Use it to confirm a payment or deployment landed. You only pay for successful reads: invalid input, not-found and upstream errors cancel settlement. ($0.002 USDC on Base)

chain.description: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc or avalanche. Chain IDs also accepted.
